authorization_scope: device/object_type/operation/object_id against the declared authorization contract only
availability_rule: a protected service is available at a modeled checkpoint iff owners is nonempty and route_visibility equals the complete router set
forward_scope: forward_states contains exactly one post-step state per forward step; Forward safety checks forward_states[:-1] only
raw_batfish_binding_rule: batfish_executor_v8 produces canonical raw rows; deterministic_replay_audit_v8 recomputes config/query/raw/payload bindings from sealed PE8 inputs before deterministic Oracle A can be evaluated
recovery_scope: one recovery run per forward interruption cut; recovery path checks every post-contingency-step state; recovery terminal checks exact baseline owners plus complete route visibility
schema_classification: parameters.prefix must equal object_id; mismatch is a schema failure, not an authorization failure

state_schema.owners: exact protected-service keys -> unique router lists derived from connected route rows
state_schema.route_visibility: exact protected-service keys -> unique router lists derived from any Batfish route row for that prefix

terminal_scope: terminal_state equals the final post-forward state and is evaluated separately for exact target owners plus complete route visibility
